note: Textbook on starting point and almost nowhere else. He is 39, plays indoor soccer, softball, skis, runs with his kids and has already lost about 30 lb in six weeks, and he frames the goal in the exact language of the ICP — 'I don't want to be okay, I want to be great' — after eight or nine years he himself calls a comfort zone. On the two commercial criteria the record is empty rather than negative: the rep never asked what he does for a living or anything about his finances, so occupation and ability to pay were never established before he was routed to the $200 self-serve product. Marked as misses because the criteria are unevidenced, not because he demonstrably failed them; the underlying finding is that the ICP screen was never run on this call.
